title: Photoshop 3D Text and Logos: Postcard, Extrusion, Materials, Lighting, and Rendering
summary: This video serves as a comprehensive introduction to creating 3D text and logos in Photoshop, covering two primary 3D workflows (Postcard 3D and Extrusion), importing logos, working with materials and lighting, adjusting camera perspectives, and rendering final images. It also explores quick 3D tricks, 2.5D “fake” 3D techniques, and path-based interlocking typography, with practical guidance on system requirements, workspace setup, rendering speed optimizations, and saving/exporting final assets. The instructor demonstrates both text and logo workflows, demonstrates how to merge 3D objects into a single scene, and provides tips on using depth of field, shadows, and multiple light sources to achieve more realistic results. The latter portion introduces a class project and advanced techniques such as using paths and Mixer Brush for 2.5D effects, before wrapping with export options and further study directions.

title: Advanced selections & masking in Adobe Photoshop - Color Range, Subject, Channel Masks, Focus Area
summary: This long-form Adobe Photoshop CC tutorial guides advanced masking and selection workflows, weaving together Select Subject, Color Range, Channel Masks, and Focus Area to create complex, non-destructive composites. It demonstrates rapid initial masking with Select Subject, then meticulous refinement in Select & Mask, including Edge Detection, Smart Radius, and Decontaminate Colors. The lesson progresses through several subjects (people and objects), emphasizing techniques to isolate skin, foliage, and colored elements, and extends into color-based masking with Color Range, localized color clusters, and grayscale previews. Practical tips include painting touch-ups with the Brush tool, moving masks between documents and into groups, saving selections, duplicating layers, and building layered shadows for realistic composites. The instructor also shows how to combine multiple techniques non-destructively via adjustment layers and layer masks, and wraps with class projects that reinforce masking and compositing concepts.

title: Photoshop Retouching Essentials: Healing Brush, Clone Stamp, Patch Tool, Liquify, Vanishing Point, and Teeth/Eye Enhancements
summary: This YouTube tutorial from Bring Your Own Laptop presents a comprehensive, technique-forward approach to Photoshop retouching. Across multiple segments, the presenter demonstrates non-destructive workflows and precise tool applications for improving facial skin, eyes, and teeth, while also showing how to handle large edits and perspective-based composites. The course launches with Healing Brush fundamentals and layered non-destructive editing, then moves into Clone Stamp and Patch Tool tricks, followed by advanced use of Liquify (including Face Aware Liquify), Vanishing Point for perspective-based mockups, quick skin tone selections, and culminates with in-depth eye and teeth retouching. The video repeatedly emphasizes working on separate layers, masking, and using adjustment layers to keep edits reversible and controllable, with exercise files and class projects included for hands-on practice.
